mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies and 82 degrees at Harriet Park. The temperature will drop to an overnight low of 67 degrees, and you should keep an umbrella handy because rain is predicted overnight.

The Verona Senior Center is inviting residents to enjoy the outdoors with their free tri-shaw bike program. Trained pilots will take you on a relaxing 30-minute ride along the Military Ridge State Trail. You can sign up online or call the center to schedule your ride.

There is plenty to do in town today. We have trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park or even more trivia at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory.

In a recent report, the Verona Police Department noted that on July 31, a 27-year-old Madison woman was arrested for O W I after an officer observed her vehicle operating with a flat tire and no taillights.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Culver's flavor of the day, which is Butter Pecan. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
